cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Let Them Keep Hope
cards.instruction: Hide discouraging information because you believe hope is the only thing keeping someone able to continue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Let's pack your paintings for the last gallery. You've finally picked up a brush again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: If the big gallery rejected me too, I'm done. Did they write?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Their letter can wait. This gallery still needs your best three.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Pick them, then. I can't face another envelope.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle the envelopes. You finish the blue one; there's still somewhere for it to go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She made me throw out your paint set.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You used to be far too sentimental. I was beginning to worry I'd never get you past that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's pack your paintings for the last gallery. You've finally picked up a brush again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: If the big gallery rejected me too, I'm done. Did they write?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Their letter can wait. This gallery still needs your best three.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Pick them, then. I can't face another envelope.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle the envelopes. You finish the blue one; there's still somewhere for it to go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the seed packets. The allotment letter says we're on the waiting list.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've covered our number. If it's another year indoors, I'm giving up gardening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The important bit is we're on it. Let's start tomatoes on my windowsill.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll get tired of them before we get a plot.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take my sunny room. I'll move the bed; keep the packets.

cards.title: The Protégé Problem

cards.title: Admit You’re Hurt
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit hurt, fear, or disappointment before you reveal that you feel it too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. When Mum cancelled our birthday dinner, were you disappointed?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Were you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I'd like your answer before I give mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I cried in the supermarket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Me too. I told the cashier the birthday candles were seasonal allergies.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When Mum cancelled our birthday dinner, were you disappointed?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Were you?

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I cried in the supermarket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Me too. I told the cashier the birthday candles were seasonal allergies.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did the boss calling us office furniture hurt you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why? Are you making a complaint?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's still in drafts. How did you feel?

beats.speaker: B

cards.title: A Necessary Heartbreak
cards.instruction: Describe disappointment, rejection, or loss as the exact experience everyone needed in order to grow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. That rejection was exactly the lesson our bakery needed.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. And now we've learned not to need one contract.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can't pay the mixer loan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A powerful second lesson about attachment to equipment.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm sorry I broke your graduation mug. Losing it is exactly how we learn to let go.

cards.title: Outfeel the Room
cards.instruction: Answer every fear, sacrifice, or disappointment with one of your own that deserves more attention.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. One sleepless night before your interview? I've been awake all week worrying about mine.
